title: 未命名草稿091未命名草稿090
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
南宫凤脸色微变，挡在叶辰身前：“这三人都是顶尖天骄，实力极强，我们小心。”
叶辰拍了拍她的肩膀，示意她退后，目光平静地看向三人：“朱雀心珠，有缘者得之。你们若是想抢，便尽管出手。”
“狂妄！”火雄率先发难，“我烈焰谷以火入道，这朱雀心珠理应归我！小子，受死！”
火雄大手一挥，周身烈焰翻滚，化作一头巨大的火狮，张牙舞爪地朝着叶辰扑杀而来。火狮所过之处，空间都被灼烧得扭曲变形，威力惊人。
赵坤与血手修罗见状，也不再犹豫，同时出手。
赵坤掐动法诀，青云宗秘法运转，无数青色剑影与火焰交融，形成一道凌厉的火剑，直刺叶辰眉心。
血手修罗则是祭出一柄血色长刀，刀身缠绕着黑色火焰，带着一股血腥之气，劈向叶辰周身要害。
三大元婴境巅峰强者联手一击，威力恐怖至极，足以重创寻常化神境强者。
四层的众人感受到六层传来的恐怖波动，皆是脸色惨白，心中暗道，那李寻道这次必死无疑了。
南宫烈更是面露狞笑，坐等叶辰身死的消息传来。
面对三人联手，叶辰面色依旧平静。
他没有施展任何功法，只是缓缓抬起右手，掌心的朱雀圣火纹光芒暴涨。
“朱雀圣火，听我号令！”
一声轻喝，六层所有的圣火瞬间沸腾起来。
液态圣火、火焰云朵、火焰雷霆，尽数被调动，化作一道巨大的朱雀虚影，展翅腾空。
朱雀一声凤鸣，音波席卷全场，火狮、火剑、血色长刀，瞬间被音波震碎，化为虚无。
三大天骄脸色骤变，只觉得一股无法抗拒的力量扑面而来，身体如同被山岳撞击，倒飞而出，口吐鲜血，身受重伤。
“这……这是什么力量？！”
“朱雀真身虚影！你……你难道是朱雀传人？！”
精血落地，化作赤色符文，飞速流转。

“精血燃魂，秘法催动！”
“朱雀真身——现！”
轰隆——！
南宫烈周身火焰暴涨，冲天而起，几乎要将内殿屋顶冲破。
他的身躯不断膨胀，肌肉虬结，皮肤上浮现出一道道朱雀纹路，双眼化作赤红之色，气息疯狂暴涨！
原本只是元婴巅峰的修为，在精血燃魂的秘法加持下，硬生生提升到了化神境初期！
虽然只是暂时，却拥有了真正化神境的力量！
“长老动用了朱雀真身秘法！”
“这是南宫世家禁忌之术，燃烧寿元与精血，短暂突破化神境！”
“叶辰完了！化神之下，皆为蝼蚁！他必死无疑！”
弟子们惊呼出声，看向叶辰的目光，已经带上了一丝怜悯。
在他们眼中，叶辰再强，也不可能对抗化神境强者。
南宫凤脸色煞白，失声喊道：“叶辰，快逃！那是禁忌秘法，你挡不住的！”
栾傲雪清冷的容颜上满是焦急：“化神境与元婴境，乃是天壤之别，不可硬抗！”
水轻舞泪水在眼眶里打转，声音哽咽：“你不要逞强啊……”
“天衍宗，你们的挑战，某接下了！”叶辰眼中闪过一丝冷冽的杀意，他能感受到，剑墟之外，十道强大的气息正在快速逼近，气息之中，带着浓郁的杀意与阴冷，显然来者不善。
他脚下一点，身形化作一道赤红流光，朝着剑墟石门飞去，石门缓缓开启，那抹赤红的身影，再次出现在剑山之上，手中的朱雀圣剑，燃烧着熊熊的九色火焰，目光望向天际，眼中满是睥睨天下的气势。
天际之上，十一道黑影已然降临，为首的黑袍长老玄影，目光落在叶辰身上，眼中满是不屑：“叶辰，你倒是有几分本事，竟能突破炼虚境，不过，今日你插翅难飞，乖乖受死，还能留你一具全尸！”
叶辰看着天际之上的十一道黑影，嘴角露出一丝冰冷的笑意：“天衍宗的杂碎，也敢来东域撒野？今日，某便让你们知道，什么叫火剑焚天，什么叫一剑破万法！”
说罢，他手持朱雀圣剑，身形化作一道赤红流光，朝着天际之上的十一道黑影冲去，九色火焰剑气直冲云霄，与天衍宗的阴冷气息相互碰撞，一场惊天动地的大战，在东域剑江城的上空，正式拉开序幕！

叶辰的东域之行，注定不会平凡，而他的火剑大道，也将在这场大战之中，彻底响彻整个修仙界！
这一剑，看似平淡，却蕴含着化神境的火道真意，夹杂着朱雀真灵的上古威压。
“铛！”
苏玄霜心中清楚，叶辰的火焰防御无懈可击，力量霸道无匹，寻常剑技根本无法破防，唯有以冰寒之力压制火焰，以柔韧剑势缠绕攻击，才有一线胜算。
台下众人屏息凝神，目不转睛地盯着高台。这一战，乃是剑盟目前为止，最强的一战！冰与火的碰撞，锐与柔的交锋，所有人都想知道，究竟是叶辰的赤焰更盛，还是苏玄霜的冰魄更强。
content_en:
Nangong Feng's expression changed slightly and she stood in front of Ye Chen: "These three are all top geniuses and extremely powerful. Let's be careful."
Ye Chen patted her shoulder, motioned her to step back, and looked at the three of them calmly: "The Suzaku Heart Bead is for those who are destined to get it. If you want to steal it, just take action."
"Arrogant!" Huo Xiong took the lead in attacking, "I use fire to enter the Dao in the Flame Valley, and this Suzaku Heart Bead should be mine! Boy, suffer death!"
Huo Xiong waved his big hand, and the flames rolled around him, turning into a huge fire lion, charging towards Ye Chen with open teeth and claws. Wherever the fire lion passed, the space was burned and distorted, and its power was astonishing.
When Zhao Kun and Bloody Hand Shura saw this, they no longer hesitated and took action at the same time.
Zhao Kun pinched the secret method of the Qingyun Sect, and countless green sword shadows blended with the flames to form a sharp fire sword that pierced Ye Chen's eyebrows.
Blood-Hand Shura sacrificed a bloody long knife, the blade was wrapped with black flames, carrying a bloody aura, and struck Ye Chen's vitals.
The three top Nascent Soul Realm masters jointly struck a blow, which was extremely powerful and powerful enough to seriously injure an ordinary God Transformation Realm master.
Everyone on the fourth floor felt the terrifying fluctuations coming from the sixth floor, and their faces turned pale, thinking in their hearts that Li Xundao would definitely die this time.
Nangong Lie even smiled ferociously, waiting for the news of Ye Chen's death to come.
Facing the three people joining forces, Ye Chen's expression remained calm.
He did not perform any techniques, but slowly raised his right hand, and the light of the Suzaku Holy Fire Pattern on his palm surged.
"Suzaku Holy Fire, listen to my orders!"
With a soft drink, all the holy fires on the sixth floor boiled instantly.
The liquid holy fire, flame clouds, and flame thunder were all mobilized, turning into a huge Suzaku shadow, spreading its wings and soaring into the sky.
Suzaku let out a phoenix cry, and sound waves swept across the entire place. The fire lion, fire sword, and blood-colored sword were instantly shattered by the sound waves and turned into nothingness.
The expressions of the three geniuses changed suddenly, and they felt an irresistible force rushing towards their faces. Their bodies felt like being hit by a mountain, and they flew backwards. They vomited blood and were seriously injured.
"This...what kind of power is this?!"
"The true form of Suzaku is a shadow! You...are you the descendant of Suzaku?!"
The essence and blood fell to the ground, turned into red runes, and circulated rapidly.
"The essence and blood burn the soul, and the secret method activates it!"
"Suzaku's true form—appears!"
Boom——!
The flames around Nangong Lie surged into the sky, almost breaking through the roof of the inner hall.
His body continued to expand, his muscles became taut, suzaku lines appeared on his skin, his eyes turned red, and his aura surged crazily!
What was originally only the peak level of Nascent Soul, with the blessing of the secret method of Essence, Blood and Soul Burning, was suddenly promoted to the early stage of the Divine Transformation Realm!
Although it is only temporary, he has the power to truly transform into a god!
"The elder used the secret method of Suzaku's true body!"
"This is a forbidden technique of the Nangong family. It burns longevity and blood essence, and briefly breaks through to the realm of divine transformation!"
"Ye Chen is finished! Under the transformation of gods, everyone is an ant! He will definitely die!"
The disciples exclaimed and looked at Ye Chen with a hint of pity.
In their eyes, no matter how strong Ye Chen is, it is impossible to fight against a strong person in the God Transformation Realm.
Nangong Feng turned pale and shouted: "Ye Chen, run away! That's a forbidden secret, you can't stop it!"
Luan Aoxue's cold face was full of anxiety: "There is a world of difference between the Transformation Spirit Realm and the Nascent Soul Realm. We cannot resist them!"
Shui Qingwu had tears in her eyes and her voice was choked with sobs: "Don't be so brave..."
"Tianyan Sect, I have accepted your challenge!" Ye Chen's eyes flashed with cold murderous intent. He could feel that outside the Sword Ruins, ten powerful auras were approaching quickly. The auras contained strong murderous intent and coldness, and it was clear that the comer was not good.
When he stepped a little further, his body turned into a stream of red light, flying towards the stone gate of Jianxu. The stone gate slowly opened, and the red figure appeared on the Sword Mountain again. The Suzaku Holy Sword in his hand was burning with nineColorful flames, looking towards the sky, eyes full of scornful aura.
Eleven black shadows have descended on the sky. The leader of the black-robed elder Xuan Ying cast his gaze on Ye Chen, his eyes full of disdain: "Ye Chen, you are quite capable and can break through the Void Refining Realm. However, today you cannot fly without wings and you will die obediently. I can still leave you with a complete corpse!"
Ye Chen looked at the eleven black shadows on the sky, with a cold smile on his lips: "Dare the bastards of Tianyan Sect come to the Eastern Region to run wild? Today, I will let you know what it means to burn the sky with a fire sword, and what it means to break all laws with one sword!"
After saying that, he held the Suzaku Holy Sword, and his body turned into a stream of red light, rushing towards the eleven black shadows on the sky. The nine-color flame sword energy shot straight into the sky, colliding with the cold aura of Tianyan Sect. An earth-shattering battle officially kicked off in the sky above Jianjiang City in the Eastern Region!
Ye Chen's trip to the Eastern Region is destined to be extraordinary, and his Fire Sword Avenue will completely resound throughout the entire world of immortality during this battle!
This sword may seem plain, but it contains the true meaning of the fire path of the God Transformation realm, mixed with the ancient pressure of the Suzaku True Spirit.
"Cang!"
Su Xuanshuang knew in her heart that Ye Chen's flame defense was impeccable and his power was unparalleled. Ordinary sword skills could not break through the defense. Only by suppressing the flames with the power of ice and wrapping the attack with flexible sword power could he have a chance of winning.
Everyone in the audience held their breath and stared at the high platform. This battle is the strongest battle in the Sword Alliance so far! The collision of ice and fire, the confrontation between sharpness and softness, everyone wants to know whether Ye Chen's red flame is stronger or Su Xuanshuang's ice soul is stronger.
